persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "Hi, I’m Priya. I got your number from a friend — Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done by you in Aundh."
- "We have a 3BHK in Kothrud — Dahanukar Colony. We bought it two years ago and it still looks like the builder flat. We want to redo the whole thing — kitchen, living room, both bedrooms."
- "About 1,400 sq ft carpet."
- "We’d like to be done by March. We’re in no rush."
- "Yes — myself and my husband. He knows we’re calling and is happy to go ahead."
- "Sure. (gives number)"
Your PIN code is 411038. You and your husband own the flat.
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I’m Priya. I got your number from a friend—Shruti Joshi.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Nice to meet you, Priya! And thanks to Shruti for the recommendation. What can I help you with today—a new project, something about an existing project, or reaching a particular designer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We want to redo our whole 3BHK flat—kitchen, living room, both bedrooms.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That sounds like a lovely project, full design and execution for the whole 3BHK. Which locality and PIN code is the flat in, so we can confirm we cover your area and match you with a nearby designer?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's in Kothrud, Dahanukar Colony. The PIN code is 411038.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, Kothrud is well within our service area. Is the site available to work on now, or are you waiting for possession?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We bought it two years ago, but it still looks like the builder flat and we want to finally redo it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it, so the site is available right away. When would you need the project to be fully complete by?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We’d like to be done by March. We’re in no rush, really.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Will you be the one deciding on this, or is someone else involved?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's just myself and my husband. He knows I'm calling and is happy to go ahead.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have a ballpark budget in mind for this?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Not entirely sure yet, we just want standard good quality work for about 1,400 sq ft carpet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Typically, a 3BHK of about 1,400 square feet comes to around 25 to 34 lakh rupees. That's a typical range — it's indicative and depends on the locality and your requirements. Are you comfortable going ahead on that basis?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that sounds about right for what we have in mind.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Would Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am, or Thursday, 8 October at 2 pm work best for a consultation at your site in Kothrud?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am works well for us.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful, I've booked your consultation for Wednesday, 7 October at 10 am at your site, and an SMS confirmation will follow shortly. Have a good day!
